questions: Verify least-privilege tool restrictions, schema validation and untrusted advice boundaries.
Compare deterministic monitoring with event-triggered model diagnosis and cheap fallback chains.
decision: Use deterministic monitoring by default and event-triggered, read-only, untrusted diagnostic advice with bounded fallback.
code_observations: assistant_triage has a strict advice schema, eligibility triggers and a capsule that does not authoritatively change task state. observer adds a separate restricted diagnostic route.
assistant_triage.evidence slices command/head/tail before calling redact, despite the redactor's intended redact-before-truncate contract. Boundary-sensitive sanitation needs a regression test.
Tool restrictions and startup guards are code-level controls; a summary prompt alone cannot enforce read-only behavior.

symbols.name: ## Native profiles and the important limitation

implementation_steps: Move sanitation ahead of any truncation of model-facing data, including command strings, output windows and failure summaries. Test split credential/header cases.

Keep explicit diagnostics local: syntax/lint errors, known missing tools and clear health failures do not need a model. Trigger one bounded diagnosis only for ambiguous stagnation or repeated unclear evidence.
Qualify each observer fallback for true read-only/no-tool or restricted-tool execution. Missing confinement disables the candidate rather than escalating its permissions.
Validate advice schema, finite confidence, allowed evidence IDs and byte limits. Label hypotheses unverified and bind the capsule to the next eligible attempt only.
Record advisory invocation cost separately and never let advice complete tasks, edit files, choose authoritative failure classes or delete evidence.
proposed_acceptance_tests: Clear deterministic errors invoke no advisory model.
A planted Authorization header or long secret split at a prior slice boundary is redacted before prompt construction.
Unknown evidence IDs, extra JSON fields, non-finite confidence and oversized hypotheses are rejected.
Unavailable cheap observer falls back only to another allowed restricted observer, otherwise skips.
Advice cannot mutate route/status and expires after its intended attempt.

alternatives.title: Continuously ask a cheap LLM to inspect output
alternatives.tradeoff: Still costly at scale and duplicates deterministic checks.

alternatives.title: Event-gated bounded advisor behind a security boundary
alternatives.tradeoff: Pays only for ambiguous diagnosis and preserves deterministic authority.

alternatives.title: Let the observer repair code or clean arbitrary logs
alternatives.tradeoff: Violates role isolation and risks modifying evidence or the product without proper validation.

cost_model: Measure avoided/used advisor calls, anomaly detection and subsequent validated repair. A low per-token price does not make a continuously polling model cheaper than deterministic tools.
unverified: Actual sandbox enforcement and account-specific observer economics require authorized live qualification. This report does not certify any hosted model as universally read-only.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
